Minutes and agendas

Council holds a variety of meetings at least once a month at the Queenscliff Town Hall.

Ordinary meetings are typically conducted at 6:30 pm on either the last or second-last Wednesday of the month. The public is welcome to attend these meetings. Special meetings are only held as required and are not necessarily open to the public. Planning review meetings are held when required, their primary purpose being to review planning applications and meet with the applicant and any objectors. These meetings are open to the public.

The minutes and agendas of all meetings are presented below for your perusal. Where a meeting has been recorded via Zoom or in-person video, a link to the recording has also been made available. You can use filter options to navigate to a particular meeting type, or to search via date or keyword.
